messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: 5xx spike detected for service=api-gateway (route=/api/generate). 5xx_rate=3.4% over 1m, p95 latency up. Paging #eng-oncall.
ashwin: oncall here, looking. Any customer-facing errors?
sophie: seeing increased client errors in Sentry for outbound upstream timeouts to EdgeCache. Affects some Dedicated customers behind routing rule rc-1.
maria: I can drop a quick query on logs, running: `logs query "service:api-gateway status:5xx AND route:/api/generate" | count by upstream, 1m`
maria: results: upstream=EdgeCache-east: 340 errors in last 1m, upstream=EdgeCache-west: 12 errors.
ashwin: thanks. Can we failover rc-1 to EdgeCache-west for the hot tenants as a mitigation?
jordan: I can flip the routing policy for rc-1 to prefer west, will do a canary first.
ops-bot: Deploy triggered: routing-change rc-1 -> prefer EdgeCache-west (canary: 5%). Runbook: swap-routing  --region west --canary 5% (initiated by jordan).
sophie: monitoring now — 5% canary in flight. Dashboards show error rate on canary = 0.8% so far.
maria: observed partial improvements. total 5xx_rate down to 1.2% across cluster after 5m.
ashwin: good. Still need to address root cause and reduce alert noise — this alert fired with only a short-lived upstream flapping for 7m. We should avoid paging for similar small upstream blips.
sophie: Agreed. Proposed quick post-incident TTPs:
- Add 5m rolling window to 5xx_rate alert (currently 1m).
- Exempt internal infra upstreams (EdgeCache) from customer-impacting paging unless >2% for 5m.
- Create a dedicated upstream-timeout dashboard with per-upstream heatmap and tenant impact.
ashwin: +1. Also add a cooldown: require sustained p95 latency > 800ms AND 5xx_rate > 1.5% before paging.
jordan: I'll create a dashboard and a PR for alert changes. Will post link.
ops-bot: Reminder: any alert rule change requires unit tests and a staged rollout to monitoring-prod.
maria: quick draft alert rule (working):
```
alert: API5xxSpike
expr: sum(rate(api_gateway_requests_total{status=~"5..",route="/api/generate"}[5m])) / sum(rate(api_gateway_requests_total{route="/api/generate"}[5m])) > 0.02
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Sustained 5xx rate >2% for /api/generate (5m)"
```
maria: That bumps threshold to 2% and uses 5m window. Happy to adjust numbers.
sophie: Also propose a non-paging lower-severity alert for 1m spikes to track flaps: severity: ticket.
ashwin: Sounds good. Please include tenant impact tags (tenant_id, route) so we can easily filter customer-facing incidents.
jordan: PR: https://git.redwood/alerts/pulls/432 — includes dashboard stub and alert rule changes. CI ok.
ops-bot: PR merged to monitoring-staging. Next: schedule canary rollout to monitoring-prod at 02:00 UTC.
sophie: I'll own postmortem notes and assign follow-ups: add dashboard, update runbook to include routing failover steps, and contact EdgeCache on-call to investigate their pod restarts during the window.
maria: filing the incident ticket now with impact assessment: ~0.4% of active tenants saw elevated errors for ~7m. No major data loss. Ticket: INC-2025.
ashwin: Thanks team. Post-incident action items: 1) alert tuning as discussed, 2) dashboard + filters, 3) contact EdgeCache ops, 4) validate routing rollback tolerances.
sophie: tagging for follow-up: @ashwin @jordan @maria. I'll draft the incident summary for the weekly ops review. :white_check_mark:
